title: Kodiak self-driving trucks: A ride in the future
excerpt: Kodiak is preparing to put fully driverless semis on highways, starting with Ikea. We took a ride to see the technology in action.
content_html:
Kodiak is gearing up to deploy its fully driverless semi trucks on highways later this year, starting with Ikea. I took a ride to see the autonomous tech in action.
